items.title: [AI Agent 智能体] 话说在 Codex 或者 Claude Code 里开 Plan 的时候，有人会给 agent veto 用户决策的想法吗？
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者在 V2EX 分享自己在 Codex、Claude Code 的 Plan 阶段主动授权 agent 否决自己决策的做法：当 Plan 的多个问题互相耦合、自己的偏保守选择可能让后续问题难度跳档时，他会给出偏好并附加「若有充分证据可以 veto 我」，agent 随后判断按他的思路整个 Plan 极大概率会变题并予以否决。他也提出疑问，在单人和单 agent 的场景下 veto 意义有限，如果放进多个 agent 互相通信的 loop 里，这个权限是否会更有价值。
items.summary_en: A V2EX developer describes explicitly granting the agent veto power over his own decisions during Plan mode in Codex and Claude Code. When questions in a plan are coupled, he states a preference plus 'if you have solid evidence, you can veto me', and in one case the agent rejected his choice, arguing the whole plan would likely change direction. He wonders whether veto matters more in a multi-agent loop where agents talk to each other than in a one-person, one-agent setup.

items.summary_en: htmx 4.0.0 is out — the team skipped 3.0 entirely, replacing XMLHttpRequest with the native fetch() API while keeping the script near 14KB and adding streaming support. It ships built-in Morphing Swap via idiomorph and an hx-partial tag, but attribute inheritance is now opt-in: parent attributes only reach children with an :inherited suffix, so patterns like hx-headers silently break with 403s. It's published under npm's next tag, not latest.

It ships as a downloadable app with documentation and a Discord community, aimed at developers and creators who want these capabilities without routing audio through a third-party cloud service.

items.title: paperclipai/paperclip

items.author: paperclipai

items.summary_en: Paperclip is an open-source MIT-licensed app for managing AI agents at work, with a quickstart, docs, and Discord community. It helps teams that need one place to supervise many agents in daily workflows. Developers running agents in production may want to give it a look.

items.title: [程序员] Muse.ai 还可以通过 Airtap 注册！

items.title: Vibe Coding 时代：Vue 消失了还是 React 太强？
items.description: Vibe Coding 时代：Vue 消失了还是 React 太强？ 作者：吴佳浩 撰稿时间：2026-3-28 最后更新：2026-3-30 引言： 最近一段时间，“vibe coding” 的项目
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在Vibe Coding（基于AI情绪化编码）时代，Vue和React两大前端框架的地位变化。作者分析了为何有人认为Vue逐渐式微而React愈发强势，并指出AI编程工具可能更倾向于与React生态兼容。文章引发读者思考：在AI辅助编码日益普及的今天，前端开发者应如何选择技术栈，以及Vue是否真的面临生存危机。
items.summary_en: This article explores the shifting status of Vue and React in the era of Vibe Coding, where AI-assisted development is driven by mood and flow. The author analyzes why some believe Vue is fading while React grows stronger, noting that AI coding tools may favor React's ecosystem. It prompts readers to think about how frontend developers should choose their stack and whether Vue truly faces an existential threat as AI-assisted coding becomes mainstream.

items.summary_en: Vitals is a Mac activity monitor that organizes usage by application instead of by process, so each running app appears as one entry rather than a scattered set of processes. That framing suits users who want to know which app is hogging the machine without reading a process tree; the listing gives no further detail on metrics or pricing.

items.summary_en: VibeDefend, from security vendor CybeDefend, is a single command-line tool meant to lock down Cursor and Claude Code. In this post he explains why the app is now free and why he is walking away from Google Play. Useful for anyone weighing open-source monetization against app-store dependency.

items.summary_zh: 文章从1800年前后一名英国手工织工讲起：他靠脚踏织机、手推梭子维生，价值全在一双手上，直到工厂里出现了新的织布机器。作者用这段历史类比当下 AI 对程序员的冲击，讨论技术替代与技能贬值。适合关心 AI 对职业前景影响的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The piece opens with an English handloom weaver around 1800, who made his living by foot and shuttle until a weaving machine appeared in the factory. It uses that history as a parallel for how AI may reshape programmers' work, asking what happens when a skill stops being the thing that pays. Aimed at developers weighing AI's effect on their careers.

items.title: 🚀 2026 年 8 月 GitHub 十大热门项目排行榜 🔥
items.description: 2026年8月GitHub十大热门：Agent 正在从「会写一段代码」走向可复用的 Skill 资产 + 可治理的记忆/文档上下文 + 更贴近真实桌面与硬件工作流。
items.summary_zh: 这是 2026 年 8 月的 GitHub 十大热门项目榜单，提炼出的趋势是 Agent 正从「会写一段代码」走向可复用的 Skill 资产、可治理的记忆与文档上下文，并更贴近真实桌面与硬件工作流。适合想把握 AI Agent 工程化方向、寻找可借鉴开源项目的开发者快速扫一遍。
items.summary_en: A roundup of GitHub's ten hottest projects for August 2026, whose through-line is that agents are shifting from writing one-off code snippets toward reusable skill assets, governable memory and document context, and workflows that reach real desktops and hardware. Developers tracking how agent engineering is maturing get a quick scan of what the community is actually building.

items.title: 记录一种很新的大屏开发方式
items.description: 尝试用AI承接原本交给第三方团队的园区楼宇三维大屏开发：从Revit/IFC模型处理、网页资产与LOD轻量化，到Three.js园区场景、楼层构件交互，再以iframe接入Vue大屏
items.summary_zh: 作者记录了自己用 AI 接手原本外包给第三方团队的园区楼宇三维大屏开发流程，涵盖 Revit/IFC 模型处理、网页资产与 LOD 轻量化、Three.js 园区场景搭建、楼层构件交互，最后用 iframe 嵌入 Vue 大屏。文中给出了一条从模型到前端集成的完整链路，适合正在做三维可视化大屏、想评估 AI 能否替代外包环节的前端开发者参考。
items.summary_en: The author describes using AI to take over a park-building 3D dashboard project that would normally go to an outside team, covering Revit/IFC model handling, web asset and LOD optimization, a Three.js scene, floor-component interactions, and finally embedding it into a Vue dashboard via iframe. It lays out a full path from raw model to front-end integration, useful for front-end developers building 3D visualization dashboards who want to judge whether AI can replace outsourced work.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。
items.summary_en: A front-end developer who goes by “小张同学” shares full-stack development practices built around writing code with AI every day. He admits his hand-coding ability has dropped noticeably and argues AI-generated code will keep replacing manual work in more scenarios. The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.
